requested_import_capacity_mw.notes: Bid states a formal application has been submitted for a 6 MW initial connection for the first building. Not independently confirmed in any grid register.

evidence_basis: Developer's AI Growth Zone bid only (May 2025): existing site infrastructure 'up to 20 MW'; SPEN budget estimate for a 20 MW 33 kV connection at £5.31m + VAT requiring 16.8 km of 400 mm2 cable; claim of a 'planned and confirmed grid power upgrade' achievable in 12-18 months; long-term options canvassed with SSEN, SPEN and Eclipse Power (IDNO), including a claimed local 2 GW offshore wind project. None verified from network-operator sources.
notes: The developer explicitly positions the site as not dependent on grid connection at scale, claiming 'island mode' operation via on-site wave/wind/solar and vanadium-flow storage. The gap between a 6 MW application plus 20 MW quote and the 2 GW-10 GW connectivity vision is unexplained. Fibre is a parallel constraint: Commsworld letter shows diverse connectivity requires two new fibre builds (Kilchattan Bay-Rothesay ~8 miles; Innellan exchange-site ~6 miles).
